input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: The exception-message predicate requires the regular expression to match the entire exception message.
- failure path: Given an exception message with a matching prefix followed by additional diagnostic text, the retry condition returns false and Tenacity propagates the exception without retrying.

Reviewer finding
- description: The match check changed from self.match.match(...) to self.match.fullmatch(...), so a pattern now has to match the entire exception message instead of a prefix.
- rationale: Trigger: retry_if_exception_message(match="timeout") with an exception whose message is "timeout after 5s". Under the old re.match semantics this matched and the retry happened. With fullmatch it returns False, so the exception is no longer retried. Impact: existing users with prefix-style patterns silently stop retrying, which changes retry behavior without any API change.
critique: The finding says the predicate now uses fullmatch, so the regex must match the whole message. A message with a matching prefix plus extra text ("timeout after 5s") then fails the check and is not retried. This is the same mechanism and failure path as the label.
